svg.title: Label what the evidence actually proves
svg.desc: Four validation layers distinguish source checks, Azure control-plane configuration, existing private-host behavior, and actual managed-agent jobs. This version does not run the fourth layer.
svg.text: Label what the evidence actually proves
AZURE PRIVATE BUILD AGENTS LAB / OPERATOR-DRIVEN EDITION
1 Offline source
Formatting, lint, contracts and docs
No Azure authentication required
Does not prove live provisioning
2 Azure control plane
Foundation and pool resource configuration
Image, capacity, endpoints and scoped roles
Does not prove an agent booted
3 Existing private host
Operator identity + private DNS / data access
Sample apply, no-op and lock behavior
Firewall only if actual route/logs match
Does not prove Managed DevOps job execution
4 Actual managed agent job
OUT OF SCOPE FOR VERSION 1
No pipeline definitions or job run included
Status remains NOT RUN
Requires separate future validation
EVERY RESULT: source host + principal + UTC time + commit + observed outcome + cleanup
A green source check is not a cloud deployment claim. A private-host result is not an agent-job acceptance result.
